d.ko: Iron Snout is a fast, colorful and brutal fighting game in which you will be helping a piglet fight for its life against hordes of wolves.
d.en: Iron Snout is a fast, colorful and brutal fighting game in which you will be helping a piglet fight for its life against hordes of wolves.
d.zh: 使用键盘控制一只超级猪打败成百上千匹狼，这款战斗游戏非常好玩，容易上瘾！

rv.t: Iron Snout 2D 격투 돼지 플레시게임 격투디펜스 돼지를 컨트롤 해 늑대 막는 게임 공중에서 때리고 방향 조절로 콤보를 만들수있고 적 무기를 집어 때리거나 날라오는 무기를 피하고 집어서 던질수도 있고 적절한 고어씬, 하지만 결정적으로 재미가 없다.
Who knew a pig beating the hell out of an endless army of wolves could be this much fun? Fast, ridiculous and surprisingly addictive. Perfect for a quick dose of chaos.
Hard to believe this is free. Very fun and very well made, far better than a very large number of paid games on Steam. You have nothing to lose so try it out!
Iron Snout is a cute little game with a fun idea, but unfortunately it just wasn't really for me. The pig is adorable though, so it gets bonus points for that. …
2D猎天使魔女，和工作室另外一部《肉泣》一样，↑↓←→四个键即可游玩，并且有铁山靠、扫堂腿、上旋腿等连招，还能爆敌人武器拿起来战斗，确实🐖界贝姐；但也有所不同，这一部《猪鼻》不能移动自身位置。 …
简单解压，好玩力推！ 虽然偏向Q版画风且只有20MB大小， 但麻雀虽小五脏俱全：打击感，可玩性，都很高，游戏细节和美术音乐方面也有特色且没有因为是Free Game就马马虎虎； …
